Synopsis:
Trump publicly dismissed the likelihood of a Russian attack on NATO territory and downplayed CIA Director Ratcliffe's Moscow visit as routine. Reuters sources partially contradict Trump, confirming NATO attack scenarios were raised in the meeting. Western intelligence is actively monitoring Russian gray-zone operations in Europe, including a potential false-flag using Ukrainian drones to trigger Article 5 ambiguity.
